title: Graham Hancock on Joe Rogan: the sarcophagus as a place for raising consciousness

tellings.quote: Graham Hancock gets to a point where he's now saying on the Joe Rogan thing, well, perhaps it's not a sarcophagus. Perhaps it's a place where you lay down inside of.

plain: The stone box in the Great Pyramid of Giza, usually called a sarcophagus, may not be a coffin at all, but a place where people lay down to raise their consciousness. The writer Graham Hancock, known for his books on lost ancient civilisations, has suggested this on The Joe Rogan Experience, the podcast hosted by Joe Rogan. The researcher Luke Caverns passes this on to Michels as Hancock's changing view.
